claim: ELI5: How are movie streaming sites like 123movies legal?
summary: Legally, it's unlikely unless they are a torrent-based site (like popcorn time is/was), in which case you participate in sharing as you're streaming. You could get a notice sent to your ISP by the studio. One notice isn't a big deal, multiple ones can get your Internet account canceled. Morally, you should remember that what you're doing by streaming those movies is theft.
